# The checker's provenance contract (check-v1 E2d), its only copy.
# tools/provenance reads it through -manifest (gate step "provenance");
# owner_e2_test.go reads the construction sites and their programs for
# TestSyntheticNodesHaveSourceOwners. Format: tools/provenance/manifest.go.
#
# A diagnostic lies in the file that holds the node it is reported at. A
# node the checker makes is in no file's tree, so it records its origin
# through made or clone (owner.go) and lies in its origin's file.

package ergo.local/prototype/internal/sketch/check
syntax ergo.local/prototype/internal/sketch/syntax
made made
clone clone

# The reviewed import allow-list (E2b round 3 review M2): each package was
# reviewed as unable to build a value of a caller's syntax node type. Any
# other import fails until it is reviewed and listed here; reflect and
# unsafe are never listed.
import cmp container/heap encoding/binary fmt go/constant go/token maps math math/bits path regexp runtime slices sort strconv strings sync unicode unicode/utf8
import ergo.local/prototype/internal/sketch/std ergo.local/prototype/internal/sketch/syntax
# math/big (L6 refinements, refine.go and typeops.go): exact integer sets
# over every integer width (a uint64 bound, 2^64-1, and the count of a set
# exceed int64). The checker uses only its integer arithmetic (big.Int),
# no host I/O; it imports no ergo.local package (go list -deps), so it
# cannot name, receive or build a syntax node.
import math/big
# runtime/v1 (G5b, the std purity fact): footprint.go calls only
# v1.BodyOf(name string) and reads Body.Pure; extern.go reads only the
# []string v1.PureImports (G9, the user extern allowlist). runtime/v1 depends on no
# ergo.local package but runtime and runtime/rt (go list -deps), so it
# cannot name, receive or build a syntax node.
import ergo.local/prototype/runtime/v1
# std/gostd (#202, IG2, the Go standard library bindings): gobinding.go
# calls only gostd.Binding(path string) (string, bool), the embedded text
# of one binding. gostd imports embed and no ergo.local package (go list
# -deps), so it cannot name, receive or build a syntax node.
import ergo.local/prototype/internal/sketch/std/gostd

# The syntax callees that yield a node, each with the only sites that may
# call it (E2b round 4 review M2). Each site parses a whole file and checks
# it as a package; a parse elsewhere makes nodes of no checked file. prelude
# parses inside its preludeOnce.Do closure, prelude$1.
# stdExternResultSet (extern.go, #206) parses the std sources, checks
# nothing and returns only type names, so no node it makes reaches a pass.
# (*hostPkg).load (gobinding.go, #202 IG2) parses one Go binding's whole
# file and checks it as that binding's package (c.files), like
# (*stdImporter).load.
callee Parse CheckSource prelude$1 (*stdImporter).load (*hostPkg).load stdExternResultSet

# The checker's own functions that parse caller text, with the sites that
# may reference them: none, so a pass cannot reach the parser through the
# package's entry.
entry CheckSource

# Every construction site: a fresh node passed to made, or a clone, with
# the owner_e2_test.go fixture, a clean program that reaches it.
site (*checker).mapInstance Ident mapShadowFixture
site (*checker).mapInstance IndexExpr mapShadowFixture
site (*checker).declareVariant TypeDecl variantFixture
site (*checker).declareVariant StructType variantFixture
site (*checker).variantParams Ident variantFixture
site (*checker).variantParams Field variantConstrainedFixture
site (*checker).variantParams FieldList variantEarlyFixture
site (*checker).varDecl VarSpec patternFixture
site (*checker).assignStmt BinaryExpr compoundFixture
# arrayType (arrays.go, L1 196y) makes the BasicLit of an array's length,
# a node the parser keeps only as text and a position (ArrayType.Len,
# LenPos), so the diagnostic "the array length ... is larger than" lies
# on the length itself. Its origin is the ArrayType, so it lies in that file.
# Every [N]T reaches it; TestArrayDiagnostics reports at it.
site (*checker).arrayType BasicLit arrayFixture
